_subset_note: Representative subset: 385 counties spanning 51 states, kept small enough to commit while still exercising choropleth breaks, ranking, percentiles and No-data paths.
_synthetic: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA — invented numbers used only to verify that the Economy UI renders. NOT real economic data. Never copy into data/economy/.
dollar_note: Dollar figures are ACS 2024 inflation-adjusted dollars and are not directly comparable to other vintages.
source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-Year Estimates
